query: I just got back from trying the new matcha boba shop downtown earlier, their taro pearls are so chewy and they even gave me a free little lemon macaron with my order, I was thinking I should bring my roommate there this weekend since she’s obsessed with all things matcha too. Oh and on my way home I saw a golden retriever puppy wearing a tiny raincoat, it kept stopping to sniff every flower bed on the sidewalk, it was honestly the cutest thing I’ve seen all week. I’ve been having some issues with my phone service though, my mobile network keeps dropping out, the Wi-Fi calling feature won’t connect no matter what I try, both the phone and messaging apps are having permission errors when I try to open them, I got a notification that I exceeded my data limit earlier, and I’m currently traveling abroad right now with roaming turned off so I can’t get any service at all, can you help me fix this?
